instructions.originalEnglish: Below are a number of statements. Please rate how often each statement is true for you.
instructions.platformChinese: 下面是一些描述你与自己想法之间关系的句子。请仔细阅读每一句，并根据你自己的真实经验，判断它在多大程度上符合你。没有对错之分，也不必反复斟酌——你的第一反应通常最准确。

groups.higherMeaning: 更高的分数表示认知融合更多，即更容易被自己的想法钩住；不是能力好坏，也不是临床诊断

items.originalEnglish: My thoughts cause me distress or emotional pain.
items.platformChinese: 我的想法让我感到痛苦或情绪上的难受。

items.originalEnglish: I get so caught up in my thoughts that I am unable to do the things that I most want to do.
items.platformChinese: 我太陷入自己的想法，以至于无法去做自己最想做的事。

items.originalEnglish: I overanalyze situations to the point where it's unhelpful to me.
items.platformChinese: 我会过度分析某些情况，到了对自己反而没有帮助的地步。

items.originalEnglish: I get upset with myself for having certain thoughts.
items.platformChinese: 我会因为自己有某些想法而生自己的气。

items.originalEnglish: I tend to get very entangled in my thoughts.
items.platformChinese: 我很容易深陷在自己的想法里。

items.originalEnglish: It's such a struggle to let go of upsetting thoughts even when I know that letting go would be helpful.
items.platformChinese: 即使我知道放下会有帮助，要放下那些令人难受的想法仍然非常困难。
